planReference.title: Tirumala 7 — 50′ × 40′ Three-Floor Corner Home with Rooflight

coordinate_system.pdf_y_axis: feet south of north plot line (0..40)

adjoining_south_and_west.note: Grass replaces the adjoining and same-block placeholder houses. Road-opposite reference landmarks remain.

notes: Three-floor 50' x 40' north-east corner home with a 12' x 5' double-height rooflight shaft (x 21-33 ft, y 26-31 ft) aligned vertically over the ground-floor dining area, first-floor guarded overlook, and second-floor raised glazed rooflight. Ground floor includes a 15' x 17' Home ICU with a 7' north slider to the verandah and a 5'6" clear west opening (no door leaf), caregiver suite, drawing room, living hall, master suite, straight-run 13'6" east-wall modular kitchen with work-bay sink and south hob, prep counter, store, wash area, and a 2/9/4 U-turn stair (18 risers @ 175 mm = 3150 mm floor-to-floor, clear headroom 2775 mm). First floor steps back to x=47 ft (520 sq ft walkable terrace) with a 389 sq ft master suite, study/meditation room, shared bath, and medium bedroom. Second floor steps back to x=44 ft (858 sq ft walkable terrace) with a 30' x 18' office & TV hall and raised non-walkable rooflight curb. All structure (columns, beams, slabs, cantilevers), waterproofing, drainage falls, and MEP/medical services are conceptual only and require licensed professional engineering design before construction.
